I'm getting a particle and have some questions about powering it with a solar panel

The only thing you really need to be conscious of is that the solar panels have high voltage at peak times. That means you really need to consider a buck-converter to ensure the power going into the battery is regulated. I also make sure I put a shotky diode on my voltage coming from the solar panel to ensure it doesn't drain the battery at night. The maximum voltage for charging is a function of the amount of cells that exist in a the battery. Generally, for a 12v motorbike battery, you'll wan to charge it with a maximum of just under 15v or it will burn it out. The bigger battery, the larger voltage it can handle.

Otherwise, they're pretty easy to figure out. Plug and play.
